algorithm: {This best-fit priority algorithm assigns each bin a priority score equal to the negative of its remaining capacity after adding the item if the bin can fit the item, otherwise negative infinity, so bins with smaller remaining space after insertion receive higher priority.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    prio = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    prio[valid_mask] = -(bins[valid_mask] - item)
    return prio
